name: SEO Settings by JordanHost – Automated SEO (built-in AI)
author: JordanHost

sections.description:
SEO Settings by JordanHost

Supercharge Your WordPress SEO with the Power of Artificial Intelligence

Struggling to keep up with the ever-changing rules of SEO?
Spending countless hours trying to write the perfect SEO titles and meta descriptions?
It’s time to let AI do the heavy lifting.

SEO Settings by JordanHost is an AI-powered SEO settings and optimization for WordPress plugin that makes expert-level optimization accessible to everyone.
We’ve integrated a powerful, free-to-use AI engine that analyzes your content and automatically generates perfectly optimized meta tags with a single click.
Stop the guesswork and start ranking higher with a smarter, faster, and more efficient approach to WordPress SEO.

► Automated SEO with a Single Click (AI-Powered)

Our flagship feature is designed to save you time and maximize your impact.
The “Generate with AI” button instantly reads your post, page, or product content and crafts compelling, high-CTR (Click-Through Rate) snippets that search engines and users will love.
* AI-Generated SEO Titles: Create catchy, keyword-rich titles under the recommended 60-character limit.**
* AI-Generated Meta Descriptions: Produce engaging descriptions that entice users to click, optimized for the ideal 160-character length.**
* AI-Generated Focus Keywords: Identify the most relevant keywords for your content to help guide your optimization efforts.**
* Truly Global and Multilingual: Whether your content is in English, Arabic, French, Spanish, or any other major language, our AI understands the context and generates meta tags in the same language.**
* Noindex Control: Easily hide any page, post, or product from search engines and the sitemap with a a single click.**

► Comprehensive On-Page SEO Toolkit

SEO Settings by JordanHost isn’t just about AI—it’s a full-featured suite of the essential tools you need for a technically sound on-page SEO foundation.
* XML Sitemaps: An auto-generated XML sitemap helps search engines like Google and Bing efficiently discover, crawl, and index all of your content, improving indexing speed for new posts.
* Advanced Schema Markup (JSON-LD): Stand out in search results!
We automatically implement structured data to help you gain rich snippets, which can dramatically increase click-through rates.
Our schema support includes:
* Article Schema for blog posts.
* Product Schema for WooCommerce products, including price, availability, and SKU.
* Organization & Local Business Schema to establish your brand identity and improve local search presence.
* Webmaster Tools Integration: Easily verify your site with Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.
* Secure File Editor: For advanced users, we provide a safe, opt-in editor for robots.txt and .htaccess, which is disabled by default for maximum security.

► Built for the Modern WordPress Ecosystem

We built SEO Settings by JordanHost to work flawlessly with the tools you already use and love.
* WooCommerce Ready: Automatically generates Product schema for your e-commerce products.
* Gutenberg & Elementor Friendly: Our meta box is perfectly integrated into the native WordPress editor and popular page builders.
* Multilingual Ready: Fully compatible with WPML, ensuring your SEO settings are translatable across your entire site.

Who is SEO Settings by JordanHost for?

  • Bloggers: Focus on creating great content while our AI handles the optimization.
  • Small Businesses: Improve your local search presence with Local Business schema and attract more customers.
  • eCommerce Stores: Optimize your WooCommerce products for better visibility and more sales.
  • Agencies & Developers: A lightweight, powerful, and reliable SEO tool for your client sites.

User Interfaces supported languages:

An intuitive interface supporting English, Spanish (Español), Italian (Italiano), French (Français), Dutch (Nederlands), Chinese (Simplified / 简体中文), Russian (Русский), Japanese (日本語), Portuguese (Português do Brasil), Arabic (العربية), Hindi (हिन्दी) and German (Deutsch).
for a user-friendly experience.

Stop struggling with complex SEO and let SEO Settings by JordanHost give you an unfair advantage.
Download today and experience the future of WordPress SEO!

External Services

This plugin connects to the JordanHost API to provide the “Generate with AI” feature. This feature is used to generate SEO-optimized titles, meta descriptions, and keywords for your posts, pages, and products.

When you click the “Generate with AI” button, the following data is sent to the JordanHost API: your post’s content, your website’s URL, and the language of your post. This information is used to analyze your content and generate relevant SEO metadata.

You can find the JordanHost terms of service and privacy policy at the following links:
* Terms of Service: https://jordanhost.net/terms-and-conditions.php
* Privacy Policy: https://jordanhost.net/privacy-policy.php
sections.installation:
1. Visit Plugins Menu > Add New in WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Search for SEO Settings by JordanHost.
  3. Install SEO Settings by JordanHost once it appears.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Navigate to the ‘SEO Settings by JordanHost’ menu to configure the settings.

Manually

  1. Upload the seo-settings-pro-by-jordanhost folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘SEO Settings by JordanHost’ menu to configure the settings.
sections.faq:
Is the AI content generation feature really free to use?

Yes. For you, the plugin user, the feature is completely free.
The plugin is connected to our service, and we manage the AI integration on our end.
There is no need for you to get your own API key.

My sitemap.xml link gives a 404 “Not Found” error. How do I fix it?

This is a common WordPress issue that is easy to fix.
Your website needs to refresh its internal list of URLs.
Simply go to Settings > Permalinks in your WordPress dashboard and click the “Save Changes” button without changing anything.
This will make your sitemap link work. We have also included a note and a button on the plugin’s General settings tab to help you with this.

What languages does the AI support?

The AI supports virtually all major global languages, including English, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Hindi, Korean, Dutch, Turkish, Polish, Swedish, Greek, Czech, Romanian, Hungarian, Norwegian, Ukrainian, Danish, Bulgarian, Catalan, Croatian, Estonian, Persian / Farsi, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Urdu, Filipino / Tagalog, Latvian, Bengali and many more.
As long as your post content is in a language with a significant presence online, the AI will generate your SEO tags in that same language.

Do I need to create an OpenAI or other AI account?

No. The plugin is designed to work out of the box.
You do not need any external accounts or API keys.

Is the robots.txt and .htaccess File Editor safe?

Yes, we have designed it with maximum security in mind. The feature is disabled by default.
To use it, you must explicitly enable it by adding a constant (define('SEO_SETTINGS_PRO_BY_JORDANHOST_ALLOW_FILE_EDIT', true);) to your website’s wp-config.php file.
This ensures only the site administrator can activate this powerful feature.
